title: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A rich and creamy Italian pasta dish made with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and pepper. Ready in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
While the pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together egg yolks, whole eggs, Pecorino, Parmesan, and plenty of black pepper.
When pasta is cooked, reserve 1 cup of pasta water. Drain spaghetti and add to the skillet with pancetta.
Remove skillet from heat and quickly pour the egg mixture over the pasta, tossing vigorously.
Add pasta water a little at a time, tossing until you get a creamy, silky sauce.
Serve immediately with extra grated cheese and black pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A beloved British-Indian curry featuring tender marinated chicken in a rich tomato and cream sauce. Aromatic and flavorful.
ingredients: 800g boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric, garam masala, cumin, and chili powder for at least 1 hour.
Thread chicken onto skewers and grill or broil until charred and cooked through, about 12-15 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pan. Sauté onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir in heavy cream and add the grilled chicken pieces.
Simmer for another 10 minutes until the sauce coats the chicken.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with basmati rice or naan bread.

title: Quick Chicken Fried Rice
description: A fast and delicious one-pan meal using leftover rice, chicken, and vegetables. Perfect for weeknight dinners.
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Cook diced chicken until golden and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil and scramble the beaten eggs. Break into small pieces.
Add frozen peas and carrots, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the cold rice, breaking up any clumps. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return chicken to the wok. Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss everything together.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve hot.

title: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
description: A healthy, vibrant salad loaded with Mediterranean vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy lemon dressing. Great for meal prep.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions. Let cool completely.
In a large bowl, combine cooled quinoa, cucumber, tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, and olives.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Top with crumbled feta and fresh parsley.
Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

title: Beef Tacos with Fresh Salsa
description: Classic Mexican-style beef tacos with homemade salsa fresca, seasoned ground beef, and all your favorite toppings.
ingredients: Sour cream and shredded cheese for topping
instructions: For the salsa: Combine diced tomatoes, red onion, jalapeño, lime juice, cilantro, and salt. Set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook ground beef and onion until browned, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave.
Assemble tacos with seasoned beef, salsa, avocado, sour cream, and cheese.
Serve with extra lime wedges on the side.

title: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
description: A comforting, velvety tomato soup with fresh basil and a touch of cream. Pairs perfectly with grilled cheese sandwiches.
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, plus extra for garnish
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes (with juices) and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add basil leaves and sugar. Use an immersion blender to purée until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil and croutons.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: Succulent shrimp tossed in a garlic butter white wine sauce with linguine. An elegant dinner ready in 20 minutes.
instructions: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet. Sear shrimp for 1-2 minutes per side until pink. Remove.
Add remaining butter and garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and shrimp back to the skillet. Toss with red pepper flakes.
Add pasta water as needed for a silky sauce.
Garnish with parsley and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
description: A colorful, healthy stir-fry packed with vegetables and crispy tofu in a savory ginger-soy sauce. Vegan and delicious.
instructions: Toss tofu cubes in cornstarch until coated.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Fry tofu until golden and crispy on all sides, about 5-6 minutes. Remove.
Add remaining oil. Stir-fry bell peppers and broccoli for 3 minutes.
Add snap peas, garlic, and ginger. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, and sesame oil.
Return tofu to the wok and pour sauce over everything. Toss to coat.
Cook for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

title: Classic Beef Burger
description: A juicy, perfectly seasoned beef burger with all the classic toppings. The ultimate comfort food for burger lovers.
instructions: Divide ground beef into 4 portions. Shape into patties slightly larger than the buns (they shrink).
Season both sides with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat a grill or cast-iron skillet over high heat.
Cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side for medium. Add cheese in the last minute.
Toast the burger buns on the grill for 30 seconds.
Assemble burgers with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup, and mustard.
Serve immediately with your favorite side.

title: Chicken and Rice Casserole
description: A hearty one-pot comfort dish with tender chicken, fluffy rice, and a creamy mushroom sauce. Perfect for feeding a family.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Season chicken thighs with paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe pan. Sear chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes until golden. Remove.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pan for 3 minutes.
Add rice, cream of mushroom soup, chicken broth, and frozen peas. Stir to combine.
Nestle the seared chicken thighs on top, skin-side up.
Cover with foil and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for another 10 minutes until chicken skin is crispy.
Let rest for 5 minutes, garnish with parsley, and serve.

title: Thai Green Curry
description: A fragrant and spicy Thai curry with vegetables and your choice of protein in a rich coconut milk sauce.
ingredients: 2 tbsp fish sauce (or soy sauce for vegan)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot or wok. Fry green curry paste for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the thick cream from the top of the coconut milk. Stir and cook for 2 minutes.
Add chicken or tofu and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, and kaffir lime leaves.
Add zucchini, bell pepper, and green beans. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in Thai basil leaves just before serving.
Serve over steamed jasmine rice.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Fluffy, healthy pancakes made with bananas and oats. Naturally sweetened and perfect for a quick breakfast.
ingredients: Maple syrup and berries for serving
instructions: Blend oats into a flour using a blender or food processor.
Add bananas, eggs, baking powder, cinnamon, milk, vanilla, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of butter.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden.
Serve stacked with maple syrup and fresh berries.

title: Creamy Tomato Basil Risotto
description: A rich and velvety Italian risotto with sun-ripened tomatoes, fresh basil, and Parmesan. Comfort food at its finest — elegant enough for a dinner party, simple enough for a weeknight.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
Extra Parmesan and basil for garnish
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large, wide pan over medium heat. Sauté onion for 4-5 minutes until translucent.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in Arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes, coating each grain in oil.
Pour in white wine and stir until fully absorbed.
Add crushed tomatoes and sugar, stir to combine.
Begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring continuously and waiting until each ladle is absorbed before adding the next.
Continue for 18-20 minutes until rice is al dente and the mixture is creamy.
Remove from heat. Stir in butter, Parmesan, and fresh basil.
Season with salt and black pepper. Let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Garnish with extra Parmesan shavings and fresh basil leaves.

title: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Vibrant bell peppers loaded with a creamy spinach, ricotta, and herb filling, baked until golden and bubbling. A satisfying Mediterranean-inspired meal.
ingredients: 4 large bell peppers (any color), halved and deseeded
2 cups fresh spinach, wilted and chopped
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place pepper halves cut-side up on a baking sheet.
Mix ricotta, spinach, garlic, egg, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Spoon filling generously into each pepper half.
Top with shredded mozzarella and Parmesan.
Drizzle with olive oil and bake for 30-35 minutes until peppers are tender and tops are golden.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.

title: Lemon Zucchini Pasta
description: Light and refreshing summer pasta tossed with ribbons of zucchini, lemon zest, garlic, and Parmesan. Ready in under 20 minutes and bursting with brightness.
ingredients: 2 medium zucchinis, spiralized or ribboned with a peeler
Zest and juice of 1 large lemon
Salt and black pepper to taste
Fresh basil or mint for garnish
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sauté garlic and red pepper flakes for 1-2 minutes.
Add zucchini ribbons and toss for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened.
Add drained pasta to the pan along with lemon zest, lemon juice, and a splash of pasta water.
Toss everything together, adding more pasta water to loosen if needed.
Remove from heat, stir in Parmesan, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve topped with fresh basil and extra Parmesan.

title: Black Bean Tacos with Mango Salsa
description: Smoky, spiced black bean tacos topped with a fresh and fruity mango salsa and a drizzle of lime crema. A fiesta in every bite.
ingredients: 2 cans black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat beans in a pan with cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and a splash of water. Mash slightly and season with salt.
Make mango salsa by combining mango, red onion, jalapeño, lime juice, and cilantro. Toss and set aside.
Mix sour cream with lime zest and a squeeze of lime juice to make lime crema.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or directly over a flame.
Assemble tacos with bean mixture, shredded cabbage, mango salsa, and a drizzle of lime crema.
Serve immediately with extra lime wedges.

title: Greek Chickpea Salad
description: A hearty, protein-packed salad with chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta tossed in a zingy oregano vinaigrette. No cooking required.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper for the dressing.
Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat.
Top with crumbled feta and fresh parsley.
Let sit for 10 minutes before serving for flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Butternut Squash Soup
description: Velvety, warming butternut squash soup with hints of ginger and coconut milk. A cozy autumn bowl that's naturally vegan and deeply satisfying.
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, peeled and cubed
Toasted pumpkin seeds and chili oil for garnish
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, and cumin. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add squash cubes and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until squash is tender.
Remove from heat and blend until completely smooth using an immersion blender.
Stir in coconut milk, return to low heat, and season with salt and pepper.
Simmer for 5 more minutes. Ladle into bowls and top with pumpkin seeds and a drizzle of chili oil.

title: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Tender cubes of paneer simmered in a rich, silky tomato and butter sauce fragrant with Indian spices. Best enjoyed with warm naan or basmati rice.
instructions: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a pan. Lightly fry paneer cubes until golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add remaining butter and sauté onion until golden brown.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 2 minutes.
Add all spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend the sauce until smooth, then return to pan.
Stir in cream and paneer. Simmer on low for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
description: Creamy smashed avocado on sourdough topped with perfectly poached eggs, chili flakes, and everything bagel seasoning. A brunch classic elevated.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Toast sourdough slices until golden and crispy.
Mash avocados with lemon juice, salt, and pepper to desired consistency.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer. Add vinegar.
Crack each egg into a small cup. Create a swirl in the water and gently slide egg in. Poach for 3 minutes.
Spread avocado mixture generously on toast.
Top each slice with a poached egg.
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes, everything bagel seasoning, and microgreens.
Serve with halved cherry tomatoes on the side.

title: Mushroom & Lentil Shepherd's Pie
description: A hearty vegetarian twist on the classic — earthy mushrooms and lentils in a savory gravy, crowned with a fluffy golden mashed potato crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Sauté onion and carrots in olive oil for 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 more minute.
Add mushrooms and cook until all liquid has evaporated, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, soy sauce, thyme, and rosemary.
Add lentils and broth. Simmer for 10 minutes until thickened. Season to taste.
Mash boiled potatoes with butter and warm milk until smooth. Season well.
Transfer lentil filling to a baking dish. Spoon mashed potatoes on top and spread evenly. Rough up the surface with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Caprese Flatbread Pizza
description: Crispy flatbread topped with fresh mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, basil, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze. Simple, beautiful, and ready in minutes.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Rub the cut side of garlic over each flatbread. Brush with olive oil.
Layer mozzarella slices across the flatbreads.
Add tomato slices on top. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until edges are crisp and cheese is bubbling.
Remove from oven and immediately scatter fresh basil on top.
Drizzle generously with balsamic glaze before serving.

title: Thai Peanut Noodles
description: Silky noodles tossed in a bold, creamy peanut sauce with lime, ginger, and sesame. Topped with crunchy veggies and roasted peanuts for the perfect texture contrast.
ingredients: Fresh cilantro and sesame seeds for garnish
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, ginger, garlic, lime juice, and warm water until smooth.
Toss noodles with the peanut sauce until well coated.
Add cabbage, carrot, and green onions. Toss to combine.
Divide into bowls and top with roasted peanuts, cilantro, and sesame seeds.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: French Onion Soup
description: A classic French bistro staple — deeply caramelized onions in a rich, savory broth, topped with a crusty crouton and a blanket of melted Gruyère.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Melt butter with olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onions and sugar.
Cook onions slowly, stirring every 10 minutes, for 45-55 minutes until deeply caramelized and golden.
Add white wine and scrape up any bits from the bottom of the pot. Cook for 3 minutes.
Add vegetable broth, thyme, and bay leaf. Simmer for 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf and season.
Preheat broiler. Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls.
Place a toasted baguette slice on top of each bowl. Pile Gruyère generously on top.
Broil for 3-4 minutes until cheese is melted, bubbling, and golden in spots. Serve immediately.

title: Vegetable Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced vegetables, caramelized onions, and fresh herbs. A celebration dish that's as aromatic as it is colorful.
ingredients: Pinch of saffron soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
instructions: Fry sliced onions in ghee until deep golden and crispy. Remove half and set aside for garnish.
To the remaining onions, add garlic, ginger, and cumin seeds. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add vegetables, turmeric, and biryani masala. Stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Mix in yogurt and cook for another 5 minutes until oil separates.
Parboil soaked rice in salted water for 5 minutes. Drain.
Layer half the rice over the vegetable base. Top with half the herbs.
Add remaining rice, drizzle saffron milk on top, and scatter remaining herbs.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes. Fluff gently and serve topped with crispy onions.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a bold, spiced tomato and pepper sauce, finished with crumbled feta and fresh herbs. A Middle Eastern brunch showstopper made in one pan.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion for 5 minutes.
Add garlic and bell peppers, cook for another 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in cumin, paprika, and chili flakes, cooking for 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until sauce thickens. Season well.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover the pan and cook for 7-9 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Scatter feta and fresh herbs on top. Serve straight from the pan with crusty bread.

title: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
description: Creamy coconut chia pudding layered with a vibrant fresh mango purée. A make-ahead breakfast that feels like dessert and requires zero cooking.
instructions: Whisk together chia seeds, coconut milk, maple syrup, and vanilla in a bowl.
Let sit for 10 minutes, stir again to break up clumps, then cover and refrigerate overnight or for at least 4 hours.
Blend mango cubes with lime juice until smooth.
Spoon chia pudding into glasses, filling halfway.
Spoon mango purée on top to create a bright layer.
Top with toasted coconut flakes and fresh mint.
Serve chilled straight from the fridge.

title: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Crispy breaded eggplant layered with marinara and melted mozzarella, baked until bubbling and irresistible. The ultimate Italian vegetarian comfort food.
instructions: Salt eggplant slices and let sit for 30 minutes to draw out moisture. Pat dry.
Set up a breading station: flour, beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs mixed with herbs and garlic powder.
Coat each eggplant slice in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry in olive oil over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until golden. Drain on paper towels.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Spread a thin layer of marinara in a baking dish.
Layer eggplant, marinara, and mozzarella, repeating until all used up. Finish with Parmesan on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest 10 minutes before serving with fresh basil.

title: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: Juicy, plump shrimp sautéed in a rich garlic butter and white wine sauce, tossed with linguine and finished with lemon and fresh parsley. An indulgent yet effortless weeknight dinner.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook linguine in generously salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain.
Pat shrimp dry and season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp in a single layer.
Cook shrimp for 1-2 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add remaining butter and garlic. Sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in white wine and let it reduce by half, about 2 minutes.
Add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water. Toss to coat in the sauce.
Return shrimp to the pan. Add lemon juice, zest, and parsley. Toss everything together.
Serve immediately with grated Parmesan and extra red pepper flakes.

title: Honey Soy Glazed Chicken Thighs
description: Sticky, caramelized chicken thighs marinated in a sweet and savory honey soy glaze with garlic and ginger. Crispy on the outside, impossibly juicy inside — perfect over steamed rice.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
Sesame seeds and sliced green onions for garnish
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, and cornstarch in a bowl.
Score the chicken thighs with a knife and season with salt and pepper. Place in a zip-lock bag with the marinade.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Heat vegetable oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Remove chicken from marinade (reserve marinade) and sear skin-side down for 4-5 minutes until golden and crispy.
Flip chicken, pour reserved marinade over the top, and transfer skillet to the oven.
Roast for 20-25 minutes, basting halfway through, until cooked through and deeply glazed.
Rest for 5 minutes. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over steamed jasmine rice.
